clauses.scope_note: Applies to Customer’s use of the Cohere API SaaS Services and Cohere Products by its Permitted Users. Customer is responsible and liable for their access and use, including breaches; Customer must immediately notify Cohere of a Permitted User breach and follow Cohere’s instructions, which may include restricting that user’s access.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligations apply when Permitted Users access or use the Services or Cohere Products; any breach by a Permitted User is deemed Customer’s breach.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to Customer’s Cohere API SaaS Services accounts and use of Cohere Products through Customer Credentials. Cohere may suspend, deactivate, or replace an account it determines may have been used for an unauthorized purpose. Customer is responsible for associated fees; Cohere disclaims responsibility for unauthorized access or use.
clauses.condition_explanation: The requirements apply to Customer’s API SaaS Services use and accounts. Customer must ensure the specified account, credential, and user-contract conditions; prompt notice is required upon actual or suspected unauthorized use.

clauses.scope_note: Unless an Order Form provides otherwise, Customer must pay fees in Cohere’s then-current price list, as Cohere may amend it. Usage exceeding Order Form service capacity or otherwise requiring additional fees is billed and must be paid under the Agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: Payment applies to API SaaS Services use; additional fees apply when usage exceeds Order Form capacity or otherwise incurs fees under the Agreement.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to fees under the Agreement for Cohere API SaaS Services. Customer must promptly update billing information and notify Cohere if the payment method is cancelled or Customer becomes aware of a potential security breach. If Customer fails to provide required billing information, Cohere may continue charging for paid-service use under the billing account.
clauses.condition_explanation: The payment and billing obligations apply when fees are payable. The continued-charging provision applies if Customer fails to provide the specified billing information.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to charges by Cohere under the Agreement for the services; it does not excuse payment of undisputed amounts.
clauses.condition_explanation: The 45-day contact deadline applies when Customer believes Cohere charged incorrectly; undisputed sums remain payable under the Agreement’s payment terms.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to amounts due under the Agreement. Late amounts accrue collection costs and monthly compounded interest at 1.5% (19.56% annually), or the maximum legal rate if lower, plus collection expenses. Cohere may suspend API SaaS Services access or terminate the Agreement in its discretion if the payment method is declined after two or more charge attempts.
clauses.condition_explanation: The payment restrictions apply to amounts due; interest and collection costs apply to late payment. The stated suspension or termination right applies after at least two declined charge attempts.

clauses.scope_note: Applies to transactions contemplated by the Agreement. Fees exclude the listed taxes and similar charges; Customer bears those charges, including interest and penalties, except taxes based on Cohere’s net income or profits.
clauses.condition_explanation: Customer’s payment obligation applies to applicable taxes, duties, tariffs, assessments, and export or import fees or similar charges arising on the covered transactions; Cohere’s net-income or profits taxes are excluded.

clauses.scope_note: Suspension of the Cohere API SaaS Services, including suspension of access to or use of Cohere Products or Services under the referenced sections, does not excuse Customer’s payment obligations.
clauses.condition_explanation: Payment obligations continue when Cohere suspends the services under the Agreement, including under Sections 2(e) or 9(e).

clauses.clause_label: Customer Warranty—Customer Data and Personal Information
clauses.scope_note: Customer warrants and covenants to Cohere regarding Customer Data in connection with the Cohere API SaaS Services. Where Customer Data contains Personal Information, Customer must have supplied required notices and disclosures, obtained applicable third-party consents and permissions, and have the authority required by law to enable Cohere’s service provision and exercise of Agreement rights, including specified processing and third-party disclosures.
clauses.condition_explanation: The no-Prohibited-Data warranty is expressly subject to Section 5(b), whose qualification is not included in this chunk. The notices, consents, permissions, and authority requirements apply to the extent Customer Data contains Personal Information.

coverage_notes: The citable chunk covers a Customer/API SaaS Services agreement context; it does not establish that these terms apply to every Cohere product, partner-installed product, or other schedule.
The license grant and general use restrictions are in the non-citable contextual preamble, so no permission or general prohibition is extracted from that preamble.
Sections 2(e), 5(b), and 9(e), the Order Form, the price list, and applicable Privacy Laws are incorporated or referenced but not supplied here; applicability and details may depend on them.

Sections 10(a)–(c) impose confidentiality-related limits on use and disclosure of confidential information, with exceptions, and Section 10(d) requires return or disposal upon Cohere’s request. Those clauses concern confidential information rather than a licensed software/model artifact, so they are not represented as artifact-use or distribution rights here.
The disclaimer at line 319 disclaims warranties concerning services, products, and outputs; it does not grant or prohibit an ASC activity. No output ownership or usage right is stated in this chunk.
